article.title: UK stops issuing student visas for four nations
article.description: The British government will end education visas to nationals from Afghanistan, Cameroon, Myanmar and Sudan.
article.content:
Britain has announced that will stop issuing student visas to people from Afghanistan, Cameroon, Myanmar and Sudan.
It will also stop issuing stilled work visas to people from Afghanistan.
